source_metadata.title: Targeting PI3K/Akt signal transduction for cancer therapy

consistency_findings: The conclusion states that none of the discussed inhibitors had entered phase III trials, while earlier narrative text and Table 3 identify phase III development for multiple agents; the contradiction was preserved rather than reconciled.
extraction_limitations: This source is a narrative review rather than a primary experimental study; secondary study results are explicitly tagged secondary_reported_result and anchored to the review.
No supplement was present in the retrieved packet.
Drug-development stages and approval statements are preserved as reported in the 2021 review and were not externally updated in this production pass.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated narrative-review recommendation or secondary-source result atom kind; defensible review assertions use atom_kind=other or author_conclusion with descriptive tags.
